recipe.loss: Complete-case mean MSE in common TRAIN-only four-channel encoding; pointwise chunks weighted by their node counts before one optimizer step
recipe.sampling: Independent complete 120-case shuffles per model seed; seed2026 continues the exact screen480 prefix, seed2027 starts fresh; cloud/scaler remain shared
recipe.selection_score: 0.5 * (validation case-mean physical U-vector relative L2 + validation case-mean signed-stress relative L2)
recipe.outputs: Original signed uXYZ [mm] and source signed scalar stress [MPa]; no teacher or gradient-loss preference for one family
recipe.shared_geometry: Same target-independent per-CAD boundary-node cloud, PointNet global32 for every family; re-encoded with gradient at each update
recipe.fno_frontend: Target-free trilinear node-splat feature means: occupancy1 + normalized xyz3 + all original25 features; append differentiable global32 in model
recipe.fno_query: Standard differentiable trilinear query of encoded4 grid at every original node, then physical decode; no voxel-label training
recipe.fno_limitation: Point-to-grid candidate, not historical TETRA10 volume-occupancy FNO. Report TRAIN3/VAL15 encoded-label roundtrip separately as representation diagnostic, not error lower bound.
recipe.transformer_context: Every original case node contributes; only official TS3 global two-pass chunks, never independent spatial blocks
recipe.transolver_pp_eval: Pinned upstream stochastic Gumbel behavior retained; fixed per-case evaluation RNG isolated from training RNG
recipe.scope_limit: Bounded cost confirmation of three routes with two seeds; no statistical significance or universal architecture ranking
recipe.selection: Measured-budget endpoint is primary cost comparison; one common validation-best checkpoint is reported separately
recipe.seed_policy: Job seed controls model and case order; canonical geometry cloud remains cloud_seed2026, scaler/data cache are reused
recipe.checkpoint_policy: Every complete 120-case pass; resume all optimizer/RNG/history/exposures; seed2026 warmstart last480, seed2027 fresh

protocol.selection_score: 0.5*(validation case-mean displacement vector relative L2 + signed-stress relative L2)
protocol.loss: mean encoded squared error across all original case nodes and four channels

geometry_encoder.coordinates: Prepared canonical xyz only; no role channels, targets or case ID

input_schema.hash: xyz3 encoded by native Hash12; original25+global32 identity condition_dim57
input_schema.FNO_global_broadcast: Append32 to every cube voxel, including occupancy0 voxels

output_schema.scaling: Encoded signed fields; trainer owns common train-only scaler/decode
output_schema.activation: Unrestricted output; no abs, clipping or stress replacement

backbone.preset_source: Slide 5 fixes 16 layers / width 256; other settings are official Model constructor defaults: 8 heads, 32 slices, MLP ratio 1, dropout 0, GELU, unified_pos false
reference_gaps: Head count, slice count, MLP ratio and dropout are not present in slide notes; official constructor defaults are used and are not claimed as exact reference settings.
Official Airplane launcher instead uses 4 layers, MLP ratio 2 and dropout 0.1; those task-specific settings are not substituted.
The source-server commit and exact target normalization constants are unavailable.
backbone.input: canonical xyz3 + original BC/material25 + shared PointNet global32
backbone.output: Four trainer-encoded signed physical field channels
backbone.context: every supplied mesh node contributes at every layer; no independent chunk evaluation
backbone.gumbel_note: Upstream ++ draws Gumbel noise during both train and eval; no guard or replacement added.
backbone.distributed: world_size=1 process group for unchanged official all_reduce calls

model.precision: PointNet/torch solvers float32 inputs; Hash native FP16 compute/FP32 master/float32 output; trainer owns autocast/TF32 policy
model.context_lifetime: Recompute encoder each optimizer update; reuse same live context across point chunks and accumulate its gradients
model.distributed_cleanup: Trainer finally calls close_selection_process_group; closes only adapter-owned ++ group

config.geometry_context: unchanged cloud_seed2026 and PointNet32; differentiable encode each complete case
config.loss: mean encoded squared error across all original case nodes and four channels
config.checkpoint_selection: 0.5*(validation case-mean displacement vector relative L2 + signed-stress relative L2)
config.precision: screen FP32/TF32; native Hash FP16 compute/FP32 master; no autocast
config.evaluation: VAL15 and TRAIN3 full nodes; ++ fixed case seed fork_rng restores training RNG
